name: Bus-section protection-boundary interface
aliases: switchgear Switchboard source and bus interfaces
summary: Shows where the defined protection zone changes between adjacent bus sections.
description: Shows where the defined protection zone changes between adjacent bus sections. A source and bus arrangement shows how incoming supplies and outgoing circuits can be connected. Breaker and tie positions determine which sections are energized and whether sources can become electrically paralleled.

In a switchgear lineup with two incomers and a bus tie, the single-line arrangement helps the engineer identify normal supply paths and which loads change source during a transfer. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Section connection and CT locations” at the input and “Protection boundary” at the output. A physical bus joint is not automatically a protection boundary.

Keep normal positions, transfer limits, source independence and protection-zone boundaries visible.
